text: Whole sheep milk and a cooked curd give a hard, compact cheese with a sharp, piquant taste. Heavy salting and longer ripening make the grating version more intense than the table cheese.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The curd is put into cylinders 25–35 cm across and 25–40 cm tall, weighing 20–35 kg.
The cheese is salted dry, in brine, or both.
A grating cheese is ripened longer, for at least 8 months.
